units.source_text: 白116用时二十二分钟，直到白120，进展都很迅速。

en.t: White 116 took twenty-two minutes, but up to White 120 the play proceeded very quickly.

units.source_text: 白120以稳健而缓慢的方式应对。

en.t: White 120 answered in a steady and deliberate manner.

units.source_text: 名人在三角形妙处严密地抑制住局势。

en.t: At the vital point of the triangle, the Master held the position tightly in check.

units.source_text: 这是胜负的关键，双方都全神贯注。

en.t: This was the key to victory or defeat, and both sides were wholly absorbed.

units.source_text: 稍一疏忽，将会损失一目以上。

en.t: The slightest lapse would cost more than one point.

units.source_text: 在这样的微妙局面下，是不能让步的。

en.t: In such a delicate position, there could be no concession.

units.source_text: 这是胜负见分晓的微妙一手，然而名人仅用了一分钟，竟使对手为之胆战心惊。

en.t: This was a subtle move that would decide the outcome, yet the Master used only one minute and somehow made his opponent tremble with fear.

units.source_text: 何况名人下白120之前早就点过目了。

en.t: Moreover, before playing White 120, the Master had already counted the points.

units.source_text: 他微颤着脑袋，快速地数着棋盘上的目。

en.t: His head trembling slightly, he rapidly counted the points on the board.
That kind of reckoning was enough to inspire awe.
